Second release candidate for open[flow] 0.1.0, focused on mix[flow] DJ playback and mixer refinements since RC1.

## Changes since RC1

- Independent stem positions, Cue audition and takeover, manual and quick loops, Slip, and coordinated beat jumps.
- Refined playing scrubs, waveform fitting, leader tempo editing and synchronization, with smoother native loop seams.
- Full-track waveform visibility during stem playback and clearer separation of Hot Cues and stem movement controls.
- Responsive four-deck mixer spacing, full-size compact controls, stereo master meters and clearer effects controls.
- A bottom help strip describing the control under the pointer, including mixer knobs and faders.
- Updated Vitest, coverage and UI together to 5.0.0, plus Node and React DOM type updates.

## Downloads

| File | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `mix-flow-0.1.0-rc.2-arm64.dmg` | mix[flow]: local stem separation, track preparation and four-deck playback. |
| `set-flow-0.1.0-rc.2-arm64.dmg` | set[flow]: the Ableton Live session manager. |
| `visual-flow-0.1.0-rc.2-arm64.dmg` | visual[flow]: the visual performance app. |
| `SessionBridge-0.1.0-rc.2.zip` | Max for Live bridge for set[flow] and visual[flow]. Keep its three device files together. |

Apple silicon only. The release workflow requires signing, notarization, Gatekeeper and stapled-ticket checks before attaching installers. mix[flow] runs independently of Live and the bridge. Its first separation downloads the managed Python environment, dependencies and model weights. Automatic updates remain disabled; install this version explicitly.

## Before the final release

Test the signed installer on a clean Mac: import, first-run engine setup, cancellation and retry, separation, four-deck playback, and persistence after quitting and reopening. Exercise Cue, loops, Slip, beat jumps and synchronization with real tracks. Verify master outputs 1/2 and headphone monitoring on outputs 3/4 with a four-channel interface.

Automated engine coverage and recorded browser audio checks accompany the DJ changes; they do not replace clean-machine or hardware testing. Live/device behavior is unverified by this release preparation.

For installation details, see [Installing](https://github.com/ryangavin/better-session-view/wiki/Installing). Include the release version, macOS version, audio hardware and reproduction steps when reporting a problem.
